name: leviathan rib
lore_descriptor: pearl-white bone, threaded with veins of dried saltwater
unidentified_descriptor: a polished length of strange bone
first_pickup_chronicle: Leviathan rib. From the beast in the deep — the bone is denser than ivory and somehow still hears the sea. Wielders report the weapon trembling when storms are near.
design_notes: Heavy exotic_organic, mid-band. Mult 1.2, weight 1.3, enchant 2. Cold-resistant + bone-dense flavor. Fills the F5 → F92 organic gap (alongside treant_heart).
